ICP Qualifier v1.0.2 Changelog

- Updated ICP criteria and expanded relevant verticals and buyer pain points.
- Overhauled scoring system to clear 100-point scale with explicit tier breakdowns (Hot/Warm/Cool/Cold).
- Streamlined output format and added detailed scoring breakdown table for each lead.
- Clarified disqualification triggers and research process.
- Minor updates to skill metadata and dependencies.

- Initial public release of the icp-qualifier skill.
- Provides detailed ICP criteria and scoring for DTC beauty/wellness brand lead qualification.
- Includes example qualifications, database field requirements, DM template, and execution rules.
- Outlines specific disqualifiers, auto-recovery, and budget management processes.
- Added skill.yaml file for deployment packaging.

Initial release of the ICP Qualifier Skill for Visual Dept lead qualification.

- Implements strict ICP criteria for DTC beauty/wellness brands with detailed qualification and disqualification checks (demographics, business metrics, product, and visual assessment).
- Introduces a comprehensive ICP scoring system to prioritize leads and set a qualification threshold.
- Provides real-world qualification/disqualification examples and a structured process for visual and product assessment.
- Outlines step-by-step lead processing, including email discovery and database entry protocols.
- Includes DM templates and Notion database field requirements for streamlined outreach and tracking.
- Supports commands for requalifying existing leads and finding new leads from specified platforms.
